title: capsicum ligustrinum
intro: Capsicum ligustrinum, commonly known as the "Wild Pepper", is a plant species belonging to the nightshade family, Solanaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health, attributed to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Capsicum ligustrinum include analgesic and antiarthritic effects, which may be beneficial for pain management and joint health. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential uses.
